title: BYBIT RUINED MY BIRTHDAY: Froze $5,200 of my life savings over a $54 transfer and drains my account with fees!
author: PolnyBread

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: brutal, and over a $54 transfer. keep every ticket number and a screenshot of each fee with its timestamp, an escalation reads very differently when it's laid out as a dated timeline.

replies.author: PolnyBread
replies.body:
I actually just did exactly that. I put together a full chronological timeline with every ticket number, timestamp, and screenshot showing how the fees drained my balance, and sent the whole package to the VARA regulator.

Honestly, I don’t know if it will actually change anything or if they’ll just brush me off with a template response. But at least the facts are officially on record now. It’s all I can do. Thanks for the advice, man.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: glad you sent it. a dated file with ticket numbers is what actually gets read, even if it takes weeks. hope the 5,200 comes back.

comments.author: GrayHairedMan
comments.body: Well on the bright side, it only ruined your birthday and not your life!
